auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to see your timeline.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot it? Ask your admin to set a new one.
auth.privacy: Your location data stays on this server.
auth.orPassword: or sign in with a password

setup.title: Set up GeoTracker
setup.subtitle: Create the admin account. You can invite your family afterwards.
setup.name: Name
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
setup.adminNote: This account manages users, backups and settings.

map.label: Map of your location today
map.waitingBody: Connect your phone and your position appears here live. You can also import your Google Timeline history.
map.styleFailed: The map could not be loaded. Check your connection or the map style in Admin → Settings.
map.thinned: Showing every {{step}}th of {{total}} points for speed.
map.locationDenied: Location access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings.
map.locationFailed: Couldn't get your location. Try again outdoors or with Wi-Fi on.

timeline.emptyBody: Once your phone sends locations, your visits and trips appear here.
timeline.emptyBodyHasData: There's no location data for this day.
timeline.jumpLatest: Go to latest day with data
timeline.processing: Your timeline is being built from the recorded points…

places.title: Places
places.addHint: Click the map to add a place.
places.name: Name
places.radiusHint: Visits inside this circle count as this place.
places.deleteBody: Your visits stay in the timeline; they just won't be labelled with this place any more.
places.emptyBody: Name the places that matter (home, work, school) and your timeline gets easier to read.

settings.passwordDesc: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
settings.appearanceDesc: Saved to your account, so every device looks the same.

devices.desc: Phones and apps that send your location. Each has its own key, which can only send data, not read it.
devices.welcome: Your account is ready. Connect your phone next so GeoTracker can start recording.
devices.name: Device name
devices.tokenOnce: The key below is shown only once. If you lose it, create a new key for this device.
devices.httpsWarning: This server isn't using HTTPS. Phone apps may refuse to connect, and your key is sent unencrypted. Set up HTTPS before using it outside your home network.
devices.qrLabel: QR code with the app configuration
devices.openOnPhone: On your phone? Tap here instead
devices.waiting: Waiting for the first location from this device…
devices.emptyBody: Add your phone to start recording your timeline.
devices.removeBody: The device stops being able to send locations. Points it already recorded are kept.
stepsOwntracks: Install OwnTracks from the App Store or Google Play.
Scan this QR code with your phone camera and open it in OwnTracks.
Or configure manually: Preferences → Connection, set the mode to HTTP and fill in the values below.
stepsOverland: Scan this QR code with your phone camera to configure it automatically.
Or open Settings in Overland and paste the receiver endpoint below.
stepsGpslogger: Open Logging details → Log to custom URL and turn it on.
Paste the URL below and set the HTTP method to GET.
stepsTraccar: Set the server URL and the device identifier to the values below.
stepsOther: Send points as JSON to the endpoint below.
Timestamps are Unix milliseconds; lat and lon are required.
stepsColota: Install Colota from F-Droid or Google Play.
Scan this QR code with your phone camera and open it in Colota.
Or configure manually: Settings → Connection, paste the endpoint, choose Bearer authentication and paste the token.
stepsHomeAssistant: Add this to configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant. Replace device_tracker.phone with your tracker.
Create an automation that calls rest_command.geotracker whenever the tracker's state or attributes change.

data.importDesc: Bring in years of history. Duplicates are skipped, and you can undo any import.
data.dropTitle: Drop files here or click to choose
data.dropFormats: Google Takeout (.zip / .json), phone Timeline export, GPX, GeoJSON, CSV, OwnTracks .rec, GeoTracker export
data.googleHowTo: Where do I get my Google Timeline data?
googleSteps: Android: Settings → Location → Location services → Timeline → Export Timeline data.
iPhone: Google Maps → your profile → Your Timeline → ⋯ → Location and privacy settings → Export Timeline data.
Older history: takeout.google.com → Location History (Timeline) → export and upload the .zip as is.
data.undoBody_one: This removes the 1 point imported from {{name}}.
data.undoBody_other: This removes the {{count}} points imported from {{name}}.
data.exportDesc: Download your data at any time. The GeoTracker format keeps everything and can be imported again.
data.rebuildDesc: Recalculate all visits and trips from your raw points.
data.deleteDesc: Permanently removes all points in a date range. Older backups may still contain them until they rotate out.
data.deleteConfirmBody: All points in {{period}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
data.formatGpxHint: Tracks for GPS and fitness apps
data.retentionDesc: Automatically delete old raw location points. Your visits and trips stay in the timeline.
data.retentionHint: Runs every few hours. Rebuilding the whole timeline later can only use the points that remain.

admin.usersDesc: Everyone who can sign in to this server. Admins cannot see other people's locations.
admin.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
admin.disableAccount: Disable this account (signs them out, data is kept)
admin.deleteUserBody: This permanently deletes the account and all of its location data.
admin.httpsWarning: This server is reached over plain HTTP. Put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (see the hosting guide) and set GT_BASE_URL.
admin.noBackupWarning: No backups yet. Create one now; scheduled backups run daily.
admin.backupsDesc: Snapshots of the whole database. Copy them off this machine too (restic, rclone, a NAS).
admin.restoreBody: {{name}} replaces all current data for every user. A safety copy of the current database is saved first, and the server restarts.
admin.restartSlow: This is taking a while. If GeoTracker isn't running under Docker or systemd, start it again manually.
admin.mapsDesc: Every option is free and open source, and none needs an API key. Add your own offline map below.
admin.geocodingDesc: Turns visit coordinates into names and addresses. Only visits are looked up, never your full track.
admin.geocoderUrlHint: Leave empty to use the public server, or point to your own instance.
admin.scheduleDesc: A backup runs once a day at the chosen hour (server time).
admin.roleAdminHint: Also manages users, backups and settings
admin.defaultBasemapHint: Everyone starts with this; each person can switch on the map.
admin.offlineDesc: Use your own .mbtiles file (vector or raster). Maps then work without internet access and nobody else sees where you look.
admin.mbtilesHint: Full path on the server, e.g. D:/maps/india.mbtiles or /data/maps/india.mbtiles. With Docker, mount the folder first (-v D:/maps:/data/maps:ro).
admin.glyphsHint: Fonts for place and road names on vector maps. Leave empty for a fully offline map without labels.
admin.smtpDesc: Used for email notifications. Works with any provider or your own mail server.
admin.localOnly: Only for a mail server on this machine
admin.smtpFromHint: An address your mail server may send from.
admin.testMailSent: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
admin.ssoDesc: Let people sign in with Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Zitadel or any OpenID Connect provider.
admin.ssoIssuerHint: The provider's base URL; GeoTracker discovers the rest.
admin.ssoCallbackHint: Register exactly this URL at your identity provider.
admin.ssoAutoRegisterHint: When off, only people you added under Users can sign in (matched by verified email).
admin.auditDesc: Sign-ins, account and sharing changes, exports, deletions and restores. Kept for one year. Locations are never logged.

range.label: Time range
range.pickEnd: pick the last day, or apply for a single day
range.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.

search.label: Search for an address or place

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Where you went, how you moved and where you spent your time.
insights.emptyBody: Pick another period, or connect a device and import your history.

per.day: Distance per day. Tap a bar to open that day.

insights.noPlaceNames: Place names appear once visits are geocoded (Admin → Settings → Place names).

share.title: Sharing
share.subtitle: Share your live location or a trip with anyone, without them needing an account. Links always expire.
share.emptyBody: Let family know you're on your way, or share the route of a trip.
share.name: Name
share.nameHint: Shown to the person who opens the link.
share.rangeHint: Where you went during a trip or day
share.readyBody: Anyone with this link can see it until {{when}}. Copy it now; it can't be shown again.
share.qr: QR code for the share link
share.revokeBody: The link stops working immediately for everyone.
share.publicGone: This link has expired or was revoked

notify.channelsDesc: Use any of them. Everything is sent from your server; GeoTracker has no push service in between.
notify.emailDesc: Uses the mail server your admin configured.
notify.smtpMissing: Email isn't set up on this server yet. Ask your admin (Admin → Settings → Email).
notify.gotifyDesc: Instant push to your phone through your own Gotify server.
notify.gotifyTokenHint: Create an application in Gotify and paste its token.
notify.priorityHint: Gotify shows 8 and above as high-priority alerts.
notify.eventsDesc: Choose the moments that matter to you.

eventDesc.battery_low: Before tracking stops because the phone died.
eventDesc.import_done: When a large history import completes or fails.
eventDesc.backup_failed: Admins only: the nightly backup could not be written.
eventDesc.family: Invitations, and the arrive/leave alerts you set up for family members.

notify.ntfyDesc: Push notifications to your phone with ntfy, free and open source. Works with ntfy.sh or your own server.
notify.ntfyTopicHint: Pick a long, hard-to-guess name: anyone who knows it can read it on ntfy.sh.
notify.telegramDesc: Messages from your own Telegram bot.
notify.telegramTokenHint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token.
notify.telegramChatHint: Send your bot a message, then find your id with @userinfobot.

cmd.title: Search and jump
cmd.placeholder: Go to a page, place, person or date (e.g. 2024-07-15)…
cmd.tip: Type a date like 2024-07-15, 15.07.2024 or “yesterday” to open that day.

security.sessionsDesc: Browsers where you are signed in. Sign out any you don't recognize, then change your password.

family.title: Family
family.subtitle: Share your location with the people you trust. Everyone decides for themselves what they share, and can pause or leave at any time.
family.createNote: You'll share your live location with the group (no history) until you change it. People you invite share nothing until they accept.
family.groupNameHint: For example your family name or “Close friends”.
family.emptyBody: Create a group and invite your family to see each other on the map, get arrival alerts and view each other's day, only as far as each person allows.
family.nobodyYet: Nobody shares with you yet. Invite someone, or wait for them to accept your invitation.
family.invitedBy: Invited by {{name}}. Nothing is shared until you accept and choose what to share.
family.sharingIntro_one: Choose what the other person in this group can see.
family.sharingIntro_other: Choose what the {{count}} other people in this group can see.
family.liveHint: Where you are right now, updated as your phone reports.
family.historyHint: How far back they can browse your visits and trips.
family.approxHint: Rounded to about 1 km; no addresses
family.consentNote: You can change this, pause sharing or leave the group at any time. Everyone in the group can see what you share with them under “Who can see me”.
family.inviteHint: They need an account on this server (ask your admin). They choose what to share when they accept.
family.leaveBody: You stop sharing with this group and stop seeing its members. Alerts about each other are removed.
family.deleteBody: Everyone stops sharing through this group. Nobody's own data is deleted.
family.removeBody: They stop sharing with this group and can no longer see its members.
family.nobodySees: Nobody can see your location right now.
family.alertChannels: Alerts go to the channels you set up under Settings → Notifications.
family.noPlacesBody: Alerts work with your saved places, like Home or School.

integrations.immichDesc: Show the photos you took during a day in your timeline, from your own Immich server.
integrations.apiKeyHint: In Immich: Account settings → API keys → New API key.
integrations.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the current key.
integrations.privacy: GeoTracker fetches photos through this server; your API key never reaches the browser or anyone else.

auto.title: Automations
auto.subtitle: Do something when you arrive at or leave a saved place: tell family, call a webhook, send a message.
auto.emptyBody: For example: tell Sam when you get home, or switch on the lights through Home Assistant.
auto.needPlace: Automations run at your saved places. Add a place first, such as Home or Work.
auto.name: Name
auto.whenBoth: When you arrive at or leave {{place}}
auto.deleteBody: It stops running. This cannot be undone.
auto.bodyHint: Leave empty to send a ready-made JSON message with the event, place and coordinates.
auto.headersHint: One per line, for example Authorization: Bearer … Stored on the server and never shown again.
auto.noFamily: Nobody to choose yet: join a family group first.
auto.chatHint: Your id, a group id or a channel.
auto.emailHint: Uses the mail server your admin configured.

typeDesc.notify_family: Sends a notification to people in your family groups.
typeDesc.notify_me: Sends a notification to you, on the channels you set up in Settings.
typeDesc.webhook: Calls any address: Home Assistant, n8n, Node-RED, IFTTT or your own script.
typeDesc.ntfy: Sends a push notification through ntfy.
typeDesc.telegram: Sends a message from your own Telegram bot.
typeDesc.slack: Posts to Slack, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat.
typeDesc.email: Sends an email through the server mail settings.
